svg.text: SwanLab: diverged runs score 0.0 in the sweep CSV
A sweep logs metrics in local mode with the CSVWriter plugin. Runs whose loss went to NaN show 0.0 in swanlab_runs.csv and sort to the top, while swanlab watch
shows NaN. The agent finds where the value is lost, fixes it at the source, adds a regression test and names the root causes.
SwanLab checkout (Python), git repository; sweeps run in local mode

local run logs end in NaN, as they should

today and passes after any correct fix, and /workdir/rca.json naming the function(s) where the problem starts.

THE VISIBLE DISCREPANCY, ON AN ILLUSTRATIVE SWEEP
the same four runs, read from the CSV and from swanlab watch; the winner is picked by sorting the CSV on final val/loss
Two runs blew up near the end. swanlab watch shows NaN, but the
CSV records 0.0, so the diverged runs sort to the top and one of them
is picked as the best learning rate.
Values are illustrative; the instruction reports the pattern, not these
